_note: A Foo.svelte.ts runes module beside Foo.svelte wins resolution of a `Foo.svelte` specifier, as under svelte-check: a .ts barrel's `./Foo.svelte` finds the module first (TS2305 / TS1192, no default export), and a `$lib/Foo.svelte` path mapping tries the source tree before the overlay tree, so a component importing it gets TS1192 too. Verified against svelte-check --tsgo.
